# Read Primitives — Predicate Ordering with Subquery

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Order filter predicates by selectivity with subquery predicate

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Order filter predicates by selectivity with subquery predicate */
SELECT
  o_orderkey,
  o_totalprice
FROM orders
WHERE
  o_totalprice > 100000
  AND o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND o_custkey IN (
    SELECT
      c_custkey
    FROM customer
    WHERE
      c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND c_nationkey = 1
  )
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def predicate_ordering_subquery_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Order filter predicates by selectivity with subquery predicate."""
    orders, customer = _tables(ctx, "orders", "customer")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    # Get customers matching criteria
    building_customers = customer.filter(
        (col("c_mktsegment") == lit("BUILDING")) & (col("c_nationkey") == lit(1))
    ).select("c_custkey")

    return (
        orders.filter((col("o_totalprice") > lit(100000)) & (col("o_orderdate") >= lit(date(1995, 1, 1))))
        .join(building_customers, left_on="o_custkey", right_on="c_custkey", how="semi")
        .select("o_orderkey", "o_totalprice")
    )
```
